documents.title: Astra Relay / Welcome
documents.body: Astra Relay opened in 1989 to study repeating signals. The station's public archive last received an official update in 1997. This is an original fictional setting.

documents.title: Maintenance log / 1997
documents.body: Final contact ended in 1997. The receiver clock recorded a repeating signal at 03:17. The timing is preserved here for the next investigator.

documents.title: Archive forum / A new transmission?
documents.body: Archivist: the signal is repeating at 03:17 again. Compare the maintenance log before drawing a conclusion. The full mystery and character dialogue are still to be written.
